title: AI agent
subtitle: Answers questions from your information and books on WhatsApp; anything clinical goes to a person
forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view this part of the AI agent.
saveForbidden: You don't have permission to change this.
saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
noProvider: Set an AI provider, model and key in Settings → Chatbot → AI first. The agent uses the same key.
chatbotNote: Turn off the chatbot's own AI and fallback reply while the agent is on, or patients get two answers.
enabled: Answer WhatsApp messages with the AI agent
emergencyHelp: Comma-separated. A message with any of these gets "call 000" and goes to a person straight away.
question: Question
documentHelp: Paste text or choose a .txt or .md file (up to 200 KB).
knowledgeEmptyHelp: The agent only answers from what you add here; without it, questions go to your team.
runsEmpty: The agent hasn't handled any messages yet.
